## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and compatibility implications.
Do not include undisclosed security findings; use private vulnerability reporting.

## Validation

List checks run, results, skipped checks, and remaining limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Every LLM-assisted commit and contribution has an assistance notice.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change.
- [ ] Security, dependency, unsafe-code, and release requirements were considered.
- [ ] Temporary files and test resources were cleaned up.

## Assistance

State whether an LLM agent participated. If so, identify the actual agent using
an `Assisted-by` notice as required by CONTRIBUTING.md.
